title: Sword in the Forest telemetry line
description: One JSON line per enemy attack aimed at the player, written to user://telemetry/.

t.description: Game time of the glint, seconds since the run started.

press_ms.description: First guard or roll press after the glint; a press after the impact still counts; null when there was none.

angle_deg.description: Angle between the player's facing and the attacker at the impact: 0 = facing it, 180 = back turned. A guard or deflect only works inside the guard arc, so a large angle marks a positioning miss, not a timing miss.
